function.name: get_religion_history
function.description: Retrieves historic events and facts related to a specified religion for a given period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start_year.description: The starting year of the period.

end_year.description: The end year of the period.

event_type.description: Optional parameter specifying the type of event. Default is 'all'.
